name: Quill
subtitle: A quiet place for your next novel
localizedDescription: Write and organize novels with free on-device chapter generation. Add full-book plot beats, then generate one chapter at a time from a prompt. Switch between Apple Intelligence and downloadable Qwen models on iPhone/iPad; Qwen also works in supported WebGPU browsers. No AI subscription, API key, or per-chapter fees. Review drafts before using them, edit freely, and keep earlier versions. Includes story notes, goals, folder sync and Word/EPUB exports. Apple Intelligence requires a supported device with iOS 26+. Qwen requires a model download and enough memory. Companion browser app: https://kharrisongit.github.io/Quill/. Install with AltStore Classic.
